title.en: An Act to Appropriate the Sum of Ten thousand Pesos for the Reconstruction of "Rizal Park" in the Municipality of Dapitan, Province of Zamboanga.

text.en:
The sum of ten thousand pesos is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the Insular Treasury
not otherwise appropriated to be expended under the supervision of the Bureau of Public Works for the
reconstruction of "Rizal Park" in the municipality of Dapitan, Province of Zamboanga.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, December 7, 1928.
